title: Roasted red pepper and garlic rice
blurb: Sweet roasted peppers stirred through buttery rice with softened shallots and garlic.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C. Cut the peppers in half, remove the seeds and white membrane, then place them cut side down on a baking tray with the olive oil and roast for 20 minutes until the skins are blistered and the flesh is soft.
While the peppers roast, peel and finely chop the shallot and garlic. Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear.
Put the stock in a saucepan and bring it to the boil, then add the rice and half the butter. Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid and simmer for 12 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
When the peppers are done, let them cool slightly then peel off the skins and slice the flesh into strips.
Melt the remaining butter in a frying pan over medium heat, add the shallot and garlic and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir the cooked rice, roasted pepper strips and the shallot mixture together in the pan. Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.
